selection_policy.hard_filter: Required features + night front-light requirement + audio/rotation when selected; budget is a hard filter using the representative VN price.
selection_policy.ranking: Primary-use fit + size fit + ecosystem + optional preferences + data confidence
selection_policy.results: 3–5 diverse candidates; near matches only when exact matches do not exist.
selection_policy.commerce: Affiliate presence never changes eligibility or ranking.
selection_policy.budget_gate: Budget uses the average of min_vnd and max_vnd when both are available; otherwise current_or_from_vnd or the available single price. A representative price above the selected cap is excluded.
selection_policy.catalog_update: Added Kindle Oasis 1/2/3, current Kindle Scribe releases, Kobo Sage, BOOX Go 10.3 (Gen II) Lumi, and the 9 Meebook models sold/listed in Vietnam. Wizard-ready requires price, core specs, and a real product image. Data fields for new Kindle/Kobo entries were normalized to the correct OS and ecosystem. Added a normalized auto_rotation field and corrected verified metadata during the full 52-model audit. Audio and rotation selections are now enforced as hard filters.
